_about: Price-integrity gate (backtester/integrity.py, run by data.load on every price file). 'overrides' are manual decisions the gate applies: action 'split' (record a split of 'ratio' new shares per old share on that day and back-adjust the earlier prices), 'rescale' (back-adjust by 1/'ratio' without recording a split: the earlier prices were on a wrong basis, no split happened) or 'ignore' (leave the day alone). 'inferred' is written by scripts/fetch_data.py after each data run: every repair the gate made, with its evidence.

2026-05-26.why: the prices before 2026-05-26 are 15x too high in the source data (-94.6% that day, SOXX +6.2%, SOXL +18.5%); Direxion's only SOXS splits around then were 1-for-20 on 2026-03-05 and 1-for-10 on 2026-07-15 (press releases of 2026-02-04 and 2026-06-10), both already in the data, so no split happened that day: the earlier prices were divided by 15 (the day is left at -18.6%, as the -3x SOXX move predicts)
